cause: Per-instruction selector work is measured independently of image layout in R1423. R1393 made existing immediate instructions pay a new plan comparison and changed their stack allocation. The new VEX32 cases currently have no simple-output plan, so they can be admitted from the existing zero-plan miss without changing the plan table or adding work on existing plan hits.
change: At the existing no-plan return only, try the already qualified low-register W0 VEX32 register writer. Keep every live option/callback check in the miss owner, retain the original vector object and all tables, and leave GCC inactive. All existing unsuccessful plan paths still need cost and native non-regression measurement.
semantic_scope: Reuse canonical vector rows and writer; admit only bare C4/C5, 32-bit mode, low register and W0 register forms. LDS/LES, memory and unsupported rows preserve fallback.
